steps.title: Habituate animals in behavior room
steps.instruction: Place the animals in the behavior room and allow them to habituate for 30 minutes before any testing to minimize stress and novelty effects.

steps.title: Familiarize animals with cylinder
steps.instruction: For two consecutive days prior to testing, let each animal explore the cylinder setup to reduce variability due to novelty.

steps.title: Place animal in cylinder
steps.instruction: Individually place each animal inside a transparent acrylic cylinder of xx cm diameter and xx cm height, positioned on a clean, stable surface.

steps.title: Record and monitor session
steps.instruction: Start video recording with a camera positioned to capture all rearing events clearly, and monitor the animal for the entire session, observing vertical exploratory behavior.

steps.title: Count rearing events
steps.instruction: After recording, manually count rearing events from the video, defining a rearing event as the animal lifting both forelimbs off the ground.

steps.title: Clean cylinder after session
steps.instruction: Thoroughly clean the cylinder after each session to remove scent cues and maintain consistency for subsequent animals.
